reasoning: 驗證目標：已在清單頂端時請求 Page Up，回捲至清單底端。為什麼這樣切：與 138 的差別在位移單位——該 leaf 是逐列的邊界，本 leaf 是逐頁的邊界，條款分列（§8.2.1）；前置條件置於頂端邊界上，越界前後各讀一次。

tcs.tc_title: Page Up at the top of the list wraps to the bottom
tcs.test_item: If a Page Up is requested and the HU is currently at the top of the list, the HU shall wrap-around to the bottom of the list
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. A SiriusXM signal source is available and the vehicle has an active subscription
2. The HU Satellite Audio source is selected on the Cabin Output Channel
3. The HU is tuned to a receivable Satellite Audio channel
4. A list is displayed whose first and last entries are known and which is longer than two screens
5. The list is positioned one page below the top of the list
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Request Page Up once and read the list position
2. Request Page Up once more and read the list position
tcs.expected_result:
1. The list is at the top of the list and the first entry is shown
2. The list is at the bottom of the list and the last entry is shown
tcs.design_method: 邊界值分析 (Boundary Value Analysis, BVA)
